implementationPlan: Add a distinct account-window destination predicate: existing common account_url OR HTTPS with no userinfo/nonstandard port, exact case-sensitive /accounts/SetSID and exact accounts.google.<frozen official suffix> membership. No www host, extra subdomain, unknown suffix, other path, encoded path spelling or trailing slash is newly admitted.

Keep regional classification data/membership independent of permission. Correct only its documentation to identify this narrowly authorized caller, and expose the immutable list only under cfg(test) for complete table coverage. Do not grant permission by comparing account_stage diagnostic strings.

Use the new predicate only through an AccountFlow account-window navigation method that checks the captured nonce and advances the existing epoch through navigate(). The existing account on_navigation closure calls this method under the same flow mutex and emits its actual decision using existing fixed categories and shared64-event budget. Stale/destroyed/replaced nonce rejects without modifying the newer flow.

Preserve on_new_window unconditional Deny, account entry/home/completed predicates, fresh observer limits and account-refresh recording fences. Redirect query/fragment stays opaque to this policy; the browser supplies it unchanged, no application parsing/replay/logging. Every subsequent navigation is independently checked by the same current-nonce closure.

Opaque query/fragment does not turn a foreign host/path into permission and is never output. A regional SetSID followed by an external destination is accepted then rejected; query continue values do not authorize the next hop.

Only current nonce navigation advances the epoch. Stale nonce, destruction and delayed old-window callbacks cannot alter a replacement flow; rejected destinations do not advance epochs or reset diagnostic budgets. Existing common navigation/popup tables remain unchanged.
